You assumed I’d cover two golden retrievers for ten days without a word. The courtesy vanished faster than the inbox.

situation: My partner invited his brother to crash on our living room couch for two weeks without checking with me beforehand. Our apartment is tiny, and now I have zero privacy in my own home while I work remotely.
texts: Zero privacy in my own space? Your assumption that space belongs to the couch isn't an invitation.

situation: I have been giving my coworker a ride to and from the office every day for the past two months to help him out. He has never once offered to chip in for gas, and yesterday he complained that my AC was too cold.
texts: The gas bill is still sitting there. Stop pretending you're helping.
The AC complaint dropped like a lead balloon yesterday. No refund for that.
Two months of rides and zero gratitude. Next round, you're paying the fare.

situation: I went to the front desk in person last month to cancel my gym membership and got a signed receipt from the manager. Today I woke up to another ninety-dollar monthly charge on my debit card, and customer support refused to reverse it.
texts: You processed a $90 monthly charge after a signed cancellation last month. The paperwork is lying.
Another $90 fee today after the manager showed you paperwork. The check isn’t even a memo.
Customer support repeated refusal after you physically canceled in person. The contract is laughably ignored.

situation: 金曜の夜は私用があると言って断ったのに、先輩から「付き合いも仕事のうち」と執拗にLINEで飲み会に誘われ、断ると露骨に無視されます。
texts: LINEでのメッセージは「仕事時間外」を盾に使うだけです。
飲み会の提案は平日が習慣です。
飲み会の招待は週末に限定されています。

situation: 私の名前で予約したコース料理を友達二人が直前にドタキャンし、キャンセル料が全額私に請求されたのに二人とも連絡がつかなくなりました。
texts: 予約情報は私の名前で確認されています。それでもキャンセル料を請求された理由を説明してください。
二人とも連絡が取れないのは、担当範囲を超えた行動だと見ています。事前に確認すべきだったという意識を共有してください。
誰がキャンセルしたかを証明する証拠がないのに、全額負担を求められた事実を理解してください。

situation: 私が出したお気に入りのウールコートがクリーニング店で縮んで戻ってきたのに、店長に「元からこういう素材」と言い張られて補償も謝罪もありません。
texts: 「縮んだと報告したら、材料の話ばかりしていた。」
「クリーニングしたはずなのに、カラーが違うと？」

situation: 実家に置いてあった私の漫画本全巻セットを、親が私の許可なく勝手に親戚の子供にあげてしまい、文句を言ったら「邪魔だった」と逆ギレされました。
texts: 本棚からずらしてしまったのは親です。私の許可なしに無茶苦茶に動かしました。
文句を言ったあとに「邪魔だった」と言い換えたのは親です。根本を読まない嘘です。
全巻セットを勝手に渡したのは親です。私のものなのに投げ出したように扱いました。

situation: 我放在公司茶水間冰箱的星巴克，貼了名字還被同事偷喝掉半杯，去問是誰喝的大家都裝死。
texts: 星巴克瓶子放在冰箱裡，你卻像揮灑灑子一樣，直接挪走了我的所有期待啦。
「誰喝了？」這句話像場劇中斷的對話，讓我明明要捍衛我的名字，反而被裝死式的沉默壓垮了。
半杯星巴克只剩下空殼，這不是一個意外，這是一場故意剝奪我的瞬間尊嚴的行為喔。

situation: 我妹沒跟我說一聲就擅自把我剛買的專櫃洋裝穿去跟朋友聚會，領口還沾了一大塊粉底液，連句道歉都沒有。
texts: 你知道嗎，我剛買的洋裝竟然被你拿去穿了喔？
這件專櫃洋裝的領口還沾著粉底液，連一句對不起都沒有啦。
你不顧我的心情就擅自穿了，這簡直像在跟我開玩笑一樣欸。

situation: 我休假去日本玩，同事一直在LINE上叫我幫忙代購三盒保養品跟點心，我婉拒之後她竟然在辦公室酸我出國很小氣。
texts: 這份代購單不是玩笑，三盒保養品與點心根本不是妳能隨口說的事！
我說過保養品不容置喙，妳卻在辦公室用嘲諷像鋼筆劃過紙張一樣挑戰我的底線！
出國是我的計畫，不是妳需要代購的玩具，妳這樣的態度讓我只想立刻回台灣！

situation: 社區保全把我的急用包裹隨便交給陌生住戶簽收，害我找了三天才找到，管委會居然說他們不負責保管。
texts: 「急用包裹在垃圾桶裡待了三天，管委會還敢這樣荒謬！」
「三個月過去，這件事還被當成沒有發生過？」

situation: I have my lunch break blocked off on my calendar every single day, but my coworker keeps scheduling mandatory meetings right in the middle of it. When I decline, she messages me asking why I am not being a team player.
texts: Meetings in the breakroom feel like rehearsals for a drama I've already written—every single one.
The calendar's emptiness screams louder than your excuses—next time, let the meeting queue wait.

situation: My close friend booked a ten-day vacation to Cabo and just assumed I would dog-sit her two golden retrievers for free without even asking first. When I told her I was busy, she acted like I was abandoning her.
texts: You scheduled this ten-day escape without a single word of acknowledgment. The retrievers deserve honesty, not empty promises.

situation: My partner invited his brother to crash on our living room couch for two weeks without checking with me beforehand. Our apartment is tiny, and now I have zero privacy in my own home while I work remotely.
texts: Do you know what hurts? You left the living room a battlefield—two bodies, one couch, and no backup plan for the quiet of my workspace.
The irony stings—two weeks of sharing space without consent, while I’m glued to my screen, fighting a silence I can’t even control.
Do you realize what you’ve done? You turned the living room into a stage for your brother, and I’m the performer forced to rehearse my patience.

situation: I have been giving my coworker a ride to and from the office every day for the past two months to help him out. He has never once offered to chip in for gas, and yesterday he complained that my AC was too cold.
texts: Do you know what hurts? I invested warmth and engine oil for two months, and now your complaint is that the air was sharper than the severance notice.
Do you know what feels like desert irony? After two months of silent service, the first complaint is about frostbite.

situation: I went to the front desk in person last month to cancel my gym membership and got a signed receipt from the manager. Today I woke up to another ninety-dollar monthly charge on my debit card, and customer support refused to reverse it.
texts: You processed another ninety-dollar monthly charge without a single word of explanation.
The manager promised a signed receipt last month, but today the silence feels like the kind of denial a storm never leaves.
Customer support refused to reverse the charge, and I’ve waited longer than the hallway between me and my dignity.

ねえ、先輩、飲み会は仕事なりと思ったら、私の気持ちを完全に無視してしまったんです。
ねえ、LINEの無視はまるで私の存在を消しゴムで消すようなものです。

補償も謝罪もない…これはまるで、私の声さえ届かない闇のクリーニング店なのです。

The customer support file referencing last month's cancellation is conspicuously absent. Reference the original file and escalate to the compliance team for retroactive validation.

連絡が取れないまま変更が成立した背景について、担当部門に再度照会をお願いいたします。

如果你這份用心放在自己身上,可能現在已經飛黃騰達了。
